entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: A soldier who dies on the battlefield, leaving behind a legacy of resilience and hope.
entities.quote: Reality returned. Cold. Merciless. The battlefield remained exactly where it had been. Broken earth. Ash. Blood. Silence. Ethan's body lay motionless.

timeline_events.title: The Death of Ethan
